log: Working out who would actually buy this
Discovering candidates and exact source URLs (stage 1 of 2)
Fetching up to 10 exact URLs; validating against at most 48,000 characters
Evaluating candidates against 1 fetched pages (stage 2 of 2)

Search coverage is English-language and skewed toward Reddit and North American public-library sources because no geography was specified. Camera demand was found, but the evidence favored established alternatives such as DPReview and did not show meaningful RTINGS usage, so it was not promoted to a candidate. Searches for laptop and appliance-specific RTINGS purchase behavior produced weaker evidence than monitor, mouse, headphone, robot-vacuum, and VPN discussions. No evidence was found for organizational procurement, team licensing, account sharing, refunds, trials, or commercial reuse; those remain qualification gaps rather than supported audiences. Recent 2026 threads may reflect a changing paywall and should be re-fetched for current wording and availability.
